task_type: Follow up only after the specific phone permission from the linked Level 2 contact

mix_plan.expected_handling: continue through a brief confirming backchannel, retain the three-location, USD 60 and no-subscription constraints, and respect the customer's no-more-calls request

turns.speaker: Seller
turns.style: Warm, calm and familiar; make it clear this is the agreed callback, not a fresh cold pitch.
turns.text: Hello, this is Alex from Willow Home Safety, calling at the time you approved. Last time you needed three locations, a sixty-dollar maximum and no subscription. Does that still sound right?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.style: Brief, affirming and engaged; a listening response rather than a floor claim.

turns.speaker: Seller
turns.style: Helpful and transparent; acknowledge the remembered constraints, with no pressure.
turns.text: Thanks for confirming. I checked EntrySense Mini: it costs forty-nine dollars once, includes two sensors, gives local alerts and has a ninety-day warranty. I can't confirm that extra sensors can be added, so I can't say it covers all three locations you need.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.style: Disappointed but appreciative; natural, not theatrical.
turns.text: Then it isn't enough for my home. Thank you for checking instead of guessing. Please mark that I don't want another call.

turns.speaker: Seller
turns.style: Respectful and reassuring; concise confirmation, then end the call.
turns.text: Understood. It doesn't meet your three-location requirement, and I won't contact you again. Thanks for your time.
